encoding_notes: Encoded from the live Guide for Authors, headless-rendered 2026-07-09 at https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/the-journal-of-hand-surgery/publish/guide-for-authors (HTTP 200). Confirmed AMERICAN Volume (ASSH), ISSN 0363-5023, EIC Gregory A. Merrell.

source_hash is of the curl-fetched Cloudflare captcha shell (594 normalized chars) because sciencedirect.com blocks non-browser fetches with a per-request captcha; the hash is unstable across runs (embeds a reference number) — see identity.source_note.

case_report is intentionally EXCLUDED: as of 1 Jan 2021 JHS no longer accepts Case Reports; the live guide lists no case-report type. This overrides the generic task hint that 'JHS accepts case_report'.

abstract.sections reflect the primary type (peer-reviewed clinical study): Purpose/Methods/Results/Conclusions/Level of Evidence. Basic-science studies substitute 'Clinical Relevance' for 'Level of Evidence'; review/technical-note/Hand-Surgery-Landscape use a single unstructured one-paragraph abstract.
JHS scientific articles explicitly OMIT a Conclusion section (guide: 'it is JHS style not to include a Conclusion section'); reflected in original_research section list.

Article-type mapping: original_research = full-length peer-reviewed scientific/basic-science study (<3000 words; Intro <500, Results <500, Discussion <1000); review = Current Concepts (<=3000 words, <=4 authors, ~20 refs, one-paragraph abstract); technical_note = Surgical Techniques (<=2500 words, online-only); letter = Letters to the Editor (<=300 words, <=3 authors, <=5 refs, <=1 table/figure).

'The Hand Surgery Landscape' (<=2000-word commentary, one-paragraph abstract, no prescribed format) and 'Review of books and media' (<=800 words) are accepted formats left unencoded — no clean ARTICLE_TYPES slot and/or no structured format specified.

references: AMA Manual of Style (latest edition) with consecutive superscript arabic numerals in citation order; numeral placed OUTSIDE (after) periods and commas but INSIDE (before) colons and semicolons (encoded in_text_punctuation='after' capturing the period/comma rule; colon/semicolon exception not representable). et_al_threshold left null — governed by AMA style but the specific author cutoff is not stated on the page.

tables placement='grouped_end': manuscript arranged as title page, abstract, body, references, figure legends, tables, figures — tables sit on separate pages grouped at the end of the manuscript file (lengthy tables go to supplementary).

figures: EPS/PDF for vector, TIFF/JPEG for photos & line art; min_dpi=300 is the halftone (photo) floor — line drawings require 1000 dpi and line/halftone combinations 500 dpi (single-value schema field holds the floor).
margins 25 mm all around (guide: 2.5-cm margins); double-spaced throughout; continuous line numbering — all stated verbatim in the guide.

Schema-forced fields the guide does NOT specify (defaults, flagged for author): layout.font family+size (guide gives no manuscript body font; Times New Roman 12 pt is a service default), layout.page_numbers.show=false (page numbering not mentioned; only line numbering is required), layout.alignment=null, misc.orcid_required=false, blinding.scrub_metadata=true (inferred from the double-anonymized-review requirement). layout.headings=null — heading case/emphasis not specified.

declarations.required: COI is required from every author on every submission (COI form); funding-role and human/animal ethics-approval statements are required for essentially all JHS content. patient_consent and trial_registration are conditional (patient details/images; registered clinical trials) so are listed in order but not marked required.

Session-A consolidation (2026-07-09): supersedes any earlier note in this list that describes source_hash as a bot-challenge 'shell' hash or that records a placeholder body font/line-spacing. Authoritative current state: source_hash is reproducible per identity.source_note; font family/size and line-spacing are null wherever the live guide is silent, so the engine preserves the author's value rather than imposing a guess.
